proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense: locate_invisible_creatures_in_shared_bright_light
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing sense surface only supports broad sense kinds like truesight. This rider is narrower: it lets beneficiaries locate Invisible creatures only when both are inside the aura's bright-light area.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws and can sense the location of any Invisible creature that is also in the Bright Light.

notes: Authored as a composite magic item and traced successfully. The invisible-creature-location aura rider was intentionally omitted because grant_sense.truesight would overstate it. The JSON includes a 10-minute activation duration, but the current tracer did not surface that duration for this magic-item activation.
